description: Generate an original song or instrumental from a text PROMPT (optionally with lyrics). The prompt sets style/instrumentation; bpm and time_signature only tag the caption (a loose hint, NOT an enforced tempo or grid); there is no key control (a key named in the prompt is not honoured) and no MIDI input. Wrong tool for "a part in D minor at the session tempo" — for that YOU write the notes and render them with doseedo_render_midi (the instrument model plays your exact MIDI); key/tempo of a reference: doseedo_analyze_song; session tempo: doseedo_get_session; the exact calls: doseedo_recipes name="compose-part". Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (typically 1–3 min) → audio URLs (pre-signed: curl -OJ <url>, no auth header, valid 24 h — see expires_at). Several files = several takes, and a take may miss or change notes — hand the user the takes or pick by listening/transcribing; never promise exact notes. Cancel: a render that has not reached the GPU yet is stopped and its credits refunded; one already rendering finishes on the GPU (its credits are spent), the job ends as canceled and the output is discarded.

bpm.description: Optional tempo HINT in BPM, written into the caption (default 120). Not enforced — the output tempo can drift from it.

duration_seconds.description: Target length in seconds (e.g. 30–120). Omit for the model default.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics to sing. Omit for instrumental.

prompt.description: Style/mood/instrumentation prompt, e.g. "warm jazz trio, brushed drums, late-night ballad".

time_signature.description: Optional meter HINT written into the caption, e.g. "4/4", "3/4". Not enforced.

name: doseedo_generate_music
